content.short: TON Bulk Sender is a CoinTool utility for sending TON or jettons to many addresses in one workflow.
content.description: TON Bulk Sender is a bulk transaction utility linked to CoinTool. It is intended for teams that need to distribute TON-based assets, such as jettons or payments, across many wallet addresses without preparing each transfer manually. The entry is categorized as a TON service tool because its primary value is operational distribution rather than trading or custody. Ton Bulk Sender is included because it helps the TON ecosystem with launch, discovery, fundraising, distribution, or early project visibility.
